page.overview:
Who is Frog Link?

When Link wakes up, he goes to the castle and asks the Triforce of Wisdom for advice on how to return to his human form. The Triforce then tells him to look for the Witch of Walls in an endless wall by an ion tree. Eventually, he and Spryte find the witch, who tells the young hero that a princess must kiss him by her own free will in order for him to be human again. Following the witch's advice, Link goes to the Underworld and finds Zelda, telling her about the cure that will free him of his frog self. Just when Zelda is about to kiss him, Ganon zaps Link and knocks him unconscious again, and Spryte, feeling sorry for the young hero, gives him a kiss on the cheek. Spryte's kiss causes Link to transform back into a human, and it is later explained that since Spryte is the daughter of the King of Fairies, that naturally makes her a princess.

As a frog, Link has a tendency to immediately eat any insect that is near him, much to Spryte's dismay.
